gcp.logging.retention.note: Logging retention: logs kept in a log bucket beyond the 30 days that storage includes, billed monthly; the _Required bucket is free. The same in every location. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set. The SKU's list unit is unconfirmed.

gcp.logging.routing.note: Log Router: no charge for routing logs to Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Pub/Sub or another project; the destination bills what it receives (exports to Cloud Storage pay no Class A operations). No SKU exists, so sync has nothing to check.

gcp.logging.storage.note: Logging storage: a one-time charge for each GiB streamed into a log bucket, which includes 30 days of storage; vended network logs are $0.25 and the _Required bucket is free. The first 50 GiB a project a month are free and ignored. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set. The SKU's list unit is unconfirmed.
